title: Cambridge IELTS 19 Test 1 Writing Task 1
directions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
prompt: The graph below gives information on the numbers of participants for different activities at one social centre in Melbourne, Australia for the period 2000 to 2020.
scenario: The graph below gives information on the numbers of participants for different activities at one social centre in Melbourne, Australia for the period 2000 to 2020.
requirements: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

visualData.title: Number of participants, by activity 2000-2020
notes: The graph covers five activities at one social centre in Melbourne, Australia.
The horizontal axis shows years from 2000 to 2020 at five-year intervals.
The vertical axis shows the number of participants from 0 to 70 at intervals of 10.
